positions.name: DecisionPerformedAsSettled
positions.frame: How is a decision performed as already settled rather than opened for deliberation?
positions.why: Across both Quinton's spoken declaration and the note-taker's recorded items, these expressions share a conviction gradient at the 'decision' pole: src-1 ratifies adoption through 'we are adopting,' src-3 commits a timeline through a commissive act, and src-5 and src-7 record those same commitments as settled decision items in a ratified list. The power dimension reads all four as exercises of legitimate or informational authority — the principal declares and the note-taker codifies, foreclosing further input. Tension between the spoken performative (src-1, src-3) and the recorded digest (src-5, src-7) is real: one enacts the settling, the other preserves it — but both perform the same 'this is decided' stance.

positions.name: LabelValueTechnicalDigest
positions.frame: How are decisions compressed into a flat technical digest of parallel label-value pairs?
positions.why: These four expressions form a single structural unit: src-4 frames the triad with 'Key decisions:' and src-5, src-6, src-7 execute it as three matched bolded-label-colon-value bullets (Database, Performance, Timeline). The register dimension reads them as technical and matter-of-fact — native jargon ('columnar queries,' 'Q3 2026') with no hedging or elaboration. The style dimension identifies the rule-of-three framing and parallelism across the bullets. Together they compress a spoken decision event into an instrumental record stripped of performance.
